items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: When I joined Benny, the only musicians that I knew well were Shad Collins, Russell Smith, Sandy Williams and Milt Robinson.

ctx.x: trumpetists. I later found out the personnel of this band.

The musicians in Carter's band were Joe Thomas, Shad Collins and Russell Smith, trumpetists, and Benny also played trumpet and alto sax. The trombone were Sandy Williams and Milt Robinson. The sax section included Benny, Carl Frye and George Dorsey on altos, Sammy Davis (not Junior) and Stafford (Pazula) Simon, tenors, Sonny White, piano, Ulysses Livington, guitar, Hayes Alvis, bass, Keg Purnell, drums, and Roy Felton, vocalist.

The Coleman Hawkin's orchestra was composed of Joe Guy and Tommy Lindsay, trumpets, Earl Hardy, trombone, Eustice Moore, Jackie Fields, altos, Ernie Powell, tenor, Gene Rodgers, piano, Charles Smith, bass, Arthur Herbert, drums and Thelma Carpenter, vocalist. The only musicians in the band that I had known before going to Europe were Jackie Fields and Gene Rodgers.
